Although the protectiveness of an Mg-rich oxide must be verified and may require formation of a continuous Mg–Al spinel rather than MgO, B is less compelling because it leaves the passivating element unidentified and implausibly groups Ti, Cu, and Zn oxides while asserting improvement in both environments.
